## Task
Do A and B name the same business concept (the same real-world thing, so the classes model one concept under different names)? Concepts that merely share attributes such as an id or a date are not the same.

### A
concept: Hive
where: HarvestRepository (uses), src/persistence/repositories.ts, component persistence

=====SOURCE-BEGIN
findByHive(hiveId: string): Harvest[] {
=====SOURCE-END=====

response.rationale: A and B are different concepts. A is the Hive itself, the colony that harvests are linked to, as shown by `findByHive(hiveId: string): Harvest[] {` in HarvestRepository. B is a Hive Scale: a separate weighing device with its own identity. It is saved with its own serial number, a reference to its hive, an owner and a phone number (`return this.scales.save({ serialNumber, hiveId, ownerId, phoneNumber });`). The graph slice also lists a separate ScaleRepository next to HiveRepository. So the scale points to a hive but is not the hive. Sharing the hiveId field is a link between the two, not a sign that they are the same thing.
